description: Search granted US patents by keyword (matched against title and abstract), title, and/or grant date range. Provide at least one of query, title, start_date, end_date. Returns title, grant date, assignee, and inventors.

query.description: Keyword(s) matched across patent title and abstract (e.g. 'lithium battery anode').

title.description: Keyword(s) matched against the patent title only.

name: patent_search
